description:
We have an immediate need for a Full Stack Developer to support Reporting Tool Suite Sustainment efforts. Support will focus on development and sustainment of two mission critical tools. The first tool tracks, administers, and archives requests for mission published reports used globally. Efforts will include maintenance/sustainment of the existing code base. The second tool is a high-performance geospatial collaboration tool that provides a single repository for formal and informal finished intelligence products. Efforts will include creating enhancements based on mission needs, as well as maintenance/sustainment of the existing code base.
 Candidates will be required to work a rotating pager schedule for emergency 24/7 call-in support as required (roughly 1 week out of every 3-4 weeks). Staff may charge 4 additional hours for the week they are on call in addition to hours worked. On average, the team is paged for after-hours support approximately once every couple of months with most issues resolvable by phone. Telework is not expected for this role.
 Salary : 140,000 - 217,000
 Active Security Clearance with LS Poly Required 
 Requirements 
 Required technical skills include:
 Java 8+
 Understanding, maintaining, and troubleshooting interfaces between multiple applications
 Elasticsearch 
 MongoDB
 Oracle
 Spring Boot
 Angular
 RESTful web services
 Solr
 
 Additional desired technical skills may include experience with:
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 Primefaces
 Node.js
 Agency reporting and dissemination tools
 Agency classification policies
 Working in an agile environment using JIRA and Confluence
 Benefits 
 
 401K: up to 3% discretionary profit sharing contribution + 100% match on the 1st 7% of pay
 PTO: 20 days per year
 Healthcare, dental, vision, Free for a single participant
 $50,000 Life insurance provided, additional voluntary life insurance available
 
 InterImage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. InterImage provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
